intent.subtype: shift result truncated inside a concatenation
intent.rationale: payload << {lane,3'b000} is a concatenation operand, so it is evaluated at 8 bits; for lane 1..3 the byte is shifted out and the word receives zero.

labels.note: payload << {lane,3'b000} inside a concatenation is self-determined at 8 bits, so the shifted bits are lost instead of landing in the upper lanes.
payload << shift inside a concatenation is self-determined at 8 bits, so the shifted byte is truncated and lanes 1-3 get zero.
